author: Paul Shea
title: This 1885-Built Anoka Gem Offers Hungry People Crispy Wings - NewsBreak
text:
By Paul Shea ,
3 hours ago Image Credit: Google Maps A 140-year-old Minnesota building is said to house the ‘best wings west of Buffalo’. While the building isn’t the oldest building in Minnesota, it might be one of the most traveled to. Here’s what people have said about the wings from inside this north suburban business.
The Building Is One Of The Oldest In Anoka Serum’s Good Time Emporium is located in downtown Anoka, inside one of the oldest buildings (built in 1885) in the city. While the building itself is 140 years old, the food inside is hot and fresh, including the 23 different sauces you can get on the ‘best wings west of Buffalo.’
Here’s What People Are Saying About The Wings At Serum’s While I’ve had my share of wings from Serum’s in the past, just because I’ve found them good doesn’t mean everyone would or will. I ended up looking at some online reviews of Serum’s specifically the wings, and here’s what people have to say.
Sara F on Yelp wrote in August of 2025 that “These are not your saucy, messy wings. They are full of flavor and so good! As someone who prefers the messy experience, I would still order them again! Go up one spice level from where you are comfortable as the spicier they are, the more flavorful they become.” Sara gave Serum’s 4 out of 5 stars in her review.
Download the WWJO Mobile App Now Alex J on Yelp wrote in August of 2025 that “They’re known for their wings and mini corn dogs. We get a large wing order of five flavors to share between five people along with corn dogs and tots. We loved the massive platter that the wings come out so nicely displayed on, and friends were impressed by the size of the wings. The corn dogs and tots were good, too.” Alex rated Serum’s 4 out of 5 stars in her review.
Steve F on Yelp wrote in July of 2025 that “…we only usually come here for the wings. The wings are really good. We always ask for them to be cooked extra crispy, and it makes a big difference.” Steve rated Serum’s 4 out of 5 stars, AND he included his favorite sauces, which were Ranchilada, Spicy Szechuan, The Flying Fajita Wing, and Colorado Coppers.
Jessica M on Google left a review from August of 2025 and said this about the wings. “The wings were fantastic, atmosphere was lively – everyone truly seemed to be having a “good time”.” Jessica left a review of 5 out of 5 stars.
Whether You Enjoy Your Wings Spicy Or Mild 23 different sauces can come with your order of wings (orders start at 12 wings and can go all the way up to 50) at Serum’s. So you’ve got some choices if you want to experience some different levels of heat.
I’m not a big spicy food guy, but I don’t mind some heat to go with my wings. I’ve usually gone with the Hot sauce, but now and then, when I am in downtown Anoka, I’ll switch it up and go with the Goldrush sauce.
Where is your go-to wing place around Central Minnesota? Let us know in the comments, and we’ll give them an honest review this fall/winter.

Beautiful Photos From Clemens Gardens This weekend was a great one to get out and do something fun. I wanted to destress, so I drove over to Clemens Gardens for a nice stroll through the gardens. What a beautiful place it is. There are flowers everywhere, as well as fountains and statues. These photos only capture part of what's available to see, but in case you haven't had a chance to visit, now is a great time to view them, as everything is in full bloom. Take a look at some beautiful photos and then make a plan to take your own trip. All of your senses will thank you. Gallery Credit: Photos by Kelly Cordes Photo by Kelly Cordes Cactus in Bloom I've been through these gardens multiple times but never noticed they had a full cactus section. Photo by Kelly Cordes Walking Paths Lined With Color The smallest of flowers and the lovely colors all blend together, and line just about every walking path there is through the gardens. It's sort of like following a red brick road to heaven. Photo by Kelly Cordes Lovely Lillies Lilies have so many lovely colors, and this was just one beautiful bunch that stood out all by itself. Photo by Kelly Cordes Don't Touch! Seeing a full section of Cactus varieties of such immense size is something I've never seen before in Minnesota, in an outdoor garden. Photo by Kelly Cordes Brilliant Blossoms I love how bright the center of this flower is; but when you look closer, you see red in the deep center, surrounded by yellow, and then more yellow on the tips of the orange flower. It almost looks like you took a paintbrush and dipped it in yellow paint and painted on the edges of each petal. Photo by Kelly Cordes Where Are They Taking Us? The magical rows and rows of flowers are everywhere in the gardens, leading you to another path, filled with more beauty. Photo by Kelly Cordes Bill and Virginia Clemens I can just imagine the surprise and excitement the first time Virginia was wheeled out to the gardens to see the lovely flowers that Bill had planted for her. Photo by Kelly Cordes Leafy Lovely's These leafy plants almost look like you could paint with them. Photo by Kelly Cordes Iron Rod Fencing All around Clemens Gardens is a beautiful Iron rod fence, that stands against the brightly colored flowers and ads a bit of charm to the whole area. Photo by Kelly Cordes Counting Flowers On The Wall..That Don't Bother Me At All One beautiful orange bloom after another appear out of thin air. They seem like they would almost glow in the dark. Photo by Kelly Cordes Blue Fountains Could the blue of the water and the sounds of trickling fountains be any more calming? I love how this fountain features birds frolicking for eternity in it's magical water. Photo by Kelly Cordes Clemens Gardens Shines Brightly Even On A Cloudy Day In this picture, it almost looks like fall, but it's just a cloudy day that makes all the brilliant colors come to life. Photo by Kelly Cordes All In A Row The flowers look like well-mannered soldiers standing in a row at attention. Photo by Kelly Cordes These Are A Few Of My Favorite Things This color isn't always one of my favorites, but when it comes to flowers, how can you not be in awe of their beauty? Photo by Kelly Cordes Purple Promises These purple flowers are so bright and cheery; I wanted to take them home. Photo by Kelly Cordes How Large Can It Get? When I see cactus, I always see them in small aquariums; but these look like they could grow to be the size of elephants! Photo by Kelly Cordes From A Distance If you've never been near this fountain, it has to be one of the most beautiful fountains in the gardens. Photo by Kelly Cordes Landscapes of green and purple These little purple brush-like flowers stood out against a backdrop of greenery. Photo by Kelly Cordes Magical Moments Do you ever see a flower unlike any other? Sometimes you just can't get enough. Photo by Kelly Cordes HAPPINESS IS... Happiness is brightly colored yellow blooms, surrounded by their tiny purple friends. They all look so cheerful, how could you view them and not leave cheerful yourself? Photo by Kelly Cordes Snowballs There are so many blooms of white, it's almost like seeing a painting of snowballs in the summer. They are breathtaking and you can see them in multiple places throughout the gardens. Photo by Kelly Cordes Green Things This beautiful green flower is almost fluorescent.
